post.description: Optional plugin mode emits tool_proposal (PluginToolProposal) before done with finish_reason=tool_calls. By default a proposal is persisted without execution. When automatic_readonly_tools is opted in after capability discovery, the host may complete only its trusted built-in balance/history reads and mark automatic=true; transfers and untrusted remote tools still await confirmation. Clients read the saved invocation and may continue once using completed invocation IDs, after durable history save. Images/resources are displayed natively; raw tool results are not client-supplied model context. Version-1 application mode additionally emits app_tool (AppToolProposal), followed by done with finish_reason=tool_calls. The client may execute only its fixed public read handlers; app_open produces a user-clicked native navigation card. It may continue with at most three bounded AppToolContext records. Reloading history never replays an application tool. Application context is separate from server-owned plugin invocation results.

automatic_readonly_tools.description: Host support for explicitly opted-in automatic trusted read-only plugin queries. Missing on older servers; clients must omit the request flag unless true.

app_tools_version.description: Support for version-1 public application tools. Missing on older servers; the client must discover this version before opting in.

messages.description: At most 24000 Unicode characters in total. Last role must be user. No client system messages, tools, credentials or provider URLs.

automatic_readonly_tools.description: Optional host opt-in, valid only with plugin_connection_id. The server may execute its trusted built-in bank balance/history reads before returning a saved proposal. Transfer and untrusted remote tools still require explicit confirmation; readOnlyHint alone never authorizes automatic execution.

app_tools_version.description: Opt in to application tools after capability discovery. Requires thinking=false and is mutually exclusive with all plugin-mode fields.

app_final_only.description: Only with application version 1 and nonempty app_context. Disable further tool proposals and explain already obtained public results; used for explicit resume without re-querying.

AiChatRequest.description: Authenticated chat. Plugin mode requires thinking=false. The server reads tools and saved invocation results for the current user; clients never supply tool results. At most eight completed invocation IDs from the selected connection. Clients must first observe automatic_readonly_tools=true in AiStatus before setting the optional flag. Existing requests retain proposal-only behavior. The eight-result turn budget also forbids preparing a ninth tool. Application mode uses app_tools_version=1, thinking=false, no plugin fields, and optional bounded app_context. It emits app_tool then done(tool_calls); after three results the provider receives no tools. These client public-data results are explicitly untrusted and cannot authorize plugin or business actions.
